summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Iván Pozo, a Spanish professional boxer born 26 August 1979 in Vigo, Spain. It describes him as retired, notes his past titles as EBU European Flyweight champion and WBO Inter-Continental Flyweight champion, and mentions his bantamweight fights and a unanimous decision win over Adonis Rivas on March 4, 2011 that retained his WBC Mundo Hispano title.
one_line: Iván Pozo is a retired Spanish professional boxer, former EBU European and WBO Inter-Continental flyweight champion.
key_facts: Iván Pozo was born on 26 August 1979 in Vigo, Spain.
Iván Pozo is a retired Spanish professional boxer.
Iván Pozo is a former EBU European Flyweight champion.
Iván Pozo is a former WBO Inter-Continental Flyweight champion.
Iván Pozo currently fights at bantamweight.
Iván Pozo defended his WBC Mundo Hispano title.
Iván Pozo defeated Adonis Rivas by unanimous decision on March 4, 2011.
The March 4, 2011 bout against Adonis Rivas was a title defense of the WBC Mundo Hispano title.
